description: Propose an X post for the Title. It is NOT published: it lands in the dashboard as "waiting for approval" and a person approves it (or it is published with publish_social_post if you hold social:publish). Optional scheduled_at (ISO 8601 UTC) proposes when it should go out. Rules: at most 280 X characters (a link counts as 23; X charges ~13x more for a post with a link), no @mentions, no invented facts.

network.description: Where to post: x (default), telegram, bluesky or discord — the network must be connected. Limits: x 280, bluesky 300, telegram 4096, discord 2000.

scheduled_at.description: Optional proposed publish time, ISO 8601 in UTC.

name: draft_social_post
title: Draft social post
